name: Info Edge (India) Ltd. (Naukri, 99acres, Jeevansathi, Shiksha)
business_summary: India's leading online classifieds: Naukri (recruitment, ~70% of billings), 99acres (real estate), Jeevansathi (matrimony), Shiksha (education); plus a large venture portfolio (startup portfolio value Rs 41,300 cr at June 2026, NiftyTrader) including listed stakes in Eternal and PB Fintech. Q2 FY27 revenue Rs 904 cr (+13%), EBITDA margin 39% (44.8% per CNBC TV18), billings Rs 822 cr (+12.8%). Market cap Rs 78,261 cr; much of the value is investment NAV. Founder Sanjeev Bikhchandani returns as CEO as Hitesh Oberoi steps down (29 Oct 2026).

exposures.mechanism: AI disrupts search/traffic (Shiksha billings -27% in Q2, MediaNama 9 Oct) and automates white-collar hiring/recruiter workflows. Recruitment (~70% of revenue) at risk if GenAI cuts white-collar hiring; +1 unit -> recruitment growth -2pp -> EBITDA -3% -> persistence 1.0 -> -4 after offsetting AI-product upside.

evidence.note: Q2 revenue +13%, EBITDA margin 44.8% (CNBC TV18), billings +12.8% to Rs822 cr, Shiksha billings -27% on AI traffic (MediaNama), dividend Rs3

exposures.mechanism: IT services hiring (~35% of Naukri job postings, model knowledge) follows US tech budgets; +5% US tech spend -> IT hiring +5% -> recruitment billings +1.5% -> EBITDA +2.5%; persistence 0.6 -> +1.5. Pack US equities +2.54 (t 3.3) agrees directionally.

evidence.note: Q2 FY27 sales 904 cr, OP 354 cr (39%), PAT 650 cr incl. other income; mcap 78,261 cr
